top_signals.title: US-Iran War Has Made Every Middle East Country a Target, Says Jane Harman
top_signals.summary: Jane Harman, former California Democratic congresswoman, said the US war in Iran has made every country in the Middle East a target, even countries that have not yet been participants in the conflict. Harman said that the danger of the conflict spreading is  'huge' and the US defense industrial base may not be prepared to address conflicts worldwide.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: China’s open-weight model lead exposes America’s AI blind spot
top_signals.summary: The future of AI may be dictated not by who builds the smartest model, but who builds the models everyone runs on. Right now, that's China.

Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
top_signals.summary: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has issued a postmortem on a data leak in which a contractor published dozens of internal CISA credentials -- including AWS Govcloud keys -- in a public GitHub repository for almost six months before being notified by KrebsOnSecurity. Experts say the gaps identified in the agency's initial response provide important lessons that all security teams should absorb.
